gloss: transfer; reassignment to a new post

definitions.gloss: transfer; reassignment to a different position or location
definitions.explanation: The act of being transferred to a new post, office, or location within the same organization. Commonly used for government officials, teachers, and company employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、{転任|てんにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転任|てんにん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The principal was transferred to another school.

examples.japanese: {転任|てんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: As a farewell greeting for my transfer, I sent an email to everyone at the office.

notes:
Compound of {転|てん} (change, move) and {任|にん} (assignment, post). Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb meaning "to be transferred."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転任|てんにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be transferred
- {転任|てんにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: transfer farewell greeting
- {転任|てんにん}{届|とどけ}: transfer notification form
- {転任|てんにん}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: new post/location after transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧: job transfer — used specifically for company employees being relocated
- ⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧: personnel change — broader term covering any change in position, department, or role
- ⟦{赴任|ふにん}→赴任：10601_funin⟧: taking up a new post — focuses on going to and starting at the new location
- ⟦{左遷|させん}→左遷：06831_sasen⟧: demotion-transfer — transfer to a lesser position, often punitive
